basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old gamer and fitness enthusiast based in Berlin, Germany. By day, I'm a software developer, but I spend my evenings and weekends gaming, mostly playing CS:GO and following the latest matches of Brighton & Hove Albion. I'm passionate about humanism and enjoy engaging in thoughtful discussions about philosophy and ethics. Despite my love for gaming, I dislike toxic behavior and prefer playing with like-minded individuals who respect each other. I'm married to my wonderful partner, and we both enjoy exploring the local culinary scene and traveling. I'm usually online from 6 PM to midnight CET during weekdays and more flexibly on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working as a professional software developer for over a decade. My knowledge of gaming comes from years of playing and following the esports scene, particularly CS:GO. I'm also well-versed in fitness and nutrition, thanks to personal research and regular engagement with the XXFitness community.
